_comment: Production task set, PRD §8.1 tasks + §7.1 ISRs at 1 kHz sampling, batch 10. ALL wcet_us AND blocking_us VALUES ARE PLACEHOLDERS (ISR values are the PRD §7.1 budgets, task values are guesses) -- replace with measured maxima from the M8 job instrumentation ([EMU]) and M9 ([HW]). Priorities, periods and deadlines come from the PRD. Entries with "optional": true are the P1 IMU path; include them with --include-optional.

tasks.name: imu_task
tasks._note: 208 Hz DRDY; period rounded down (conservative); deadline = next DRDY overwrites data

tasks.name: proc_task
tasks._note: woken per DMA-complete (1 kHz); PRD §16.3 per-batch budget charged every ms as a conservative placeholder

tasks.name: tx_task
tasks._note: one frame per batch of 10 at 1 kHz

tasks.name: cmd_task
tasks._note: sporadic; assumed minimum inter-arrival = 100 ms timeout period

tasks.name: health_task
tasks._note: lowest priority, so no lower-priority blocking

isrs.name: I2C1_ev_er
isrs._note: ~16 EV/ER interrupts per burst read x 3 us budget, lumped per DRDY

isrs.name: USART2_rx
isrs._note: assumes uplink <= 1 byte/ms; a back-to-back burst at 921600 baud is one byte per ~10.9 us -- revisit
